bodyHtml:
MEGA-120 High-Pressure Booster Tank

120-Liter (32 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-120 is a pressurized water system component designed for high-rise buildings, fire systems, and demanding long-distance pressure support. With a 120-liter (32-gallon) capacity, it reliably maintains water pressure at a set, consistent level.

 

Built for high-stress environments, this tank supports a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. It is factory-pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to ensure stable performance and prevent pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes.

 

Measuring 39.0 cm in diameter and 113.9 cm in height, the tank includes a heavy-duty base for added stability. It is an ideal high-capacity solution for residential and commercial booster setups requiring exceptional high-pressure performance and flow rates.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-120 is a 120-liter (32-gallon) high-performance diaphragm tank, engineered as the definitive solution for mid-sized water system stabilization. Utilizing a specialized FDA-grade polypropylene liner integrated with a premium butyl diaphragm, it ensures a dedicated "Safe Water Zone" by preventing any contact between the liquid and the tank's metallic shell.

Key technical advantages include a 100% Nitrogen pre-charge and a 16-bar (232 PSI) pressure rating, which significantly outperforms standard industry tanks. This configuration ensures more stable pressure cycles and minimizes pump "short-cycling," directly preventing motor burnout and extending equipment lifespan. 

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade epoxy powder finish, the MEGA-120 offers superior oxidation resistance. Equipped with a premium 1” Stainless Steel lead-free connector, this CE and ISO 9001 certified unit provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free solution for critical high-pressure applications.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-120 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Fire systems and water machining (20L per min flow rate applications)
  • Residential and commercial booster pump systems

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : What makes the MEGA-120 different from standard pressure tanks?

The MEGA-120 is part of the MEGA-PLUS series, which is specifically engineered to handle a much higher maximum working pressure of 16 bar. Additionally, it features a polypropylene liner that creates a completely safe water zone, meaning it can be safely used for high-pressure drinking water systems without metallic contamination.

Q2 : Why is the MEGA-120 superior for high-rise building booster systems?

Standard 10-bar tanks cannot withstand the immense static head pressure of high-rise plumbing. The MEGA-120’s 16-Bar carbon steel shell safely provides long-distance pressure support without the risk of catastrophic tank rupture.
 

Q3 : What internal liner material does the MEGA-120 use to protect the water?

It uses a polypropylene liner that, combined with the diaphragm, creates a safe water zone by keeping water from touching the metallic surface.
